style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting, matching the reference image's prismatic purple crystal-cave palette: lavender and violet rock, teal-green moss, pink wisteria, glowing pastel crystals and mushrooms. Painterly, soft, slightly muted and low contrast so it reads as scenery behind a game, with a soft dark outline and no harsh highlights. One single isolated object, centred, entirely inside the frame. Draw no ground, no floor, no characters, no text, no shadow.

frames.name: hanging_roots
frames.prompt: A tall cluster of long hanging tree roots and wisteria vines dangling straight down, thicker at the top and thinning to loose tips, seen from the side.

frames.name: stalactite_cluster
frames.prompt: A cluster of three to five stalactites of different lengths hanging from a small lump of ceiling rock, with a little moss and a few tiny glowing crystals.

frames.name: rock_pillar
frames.prompt: A tall natural rock pillar rising from the ground, wider at the base and the top, narrower in the middle, covered in moss with a few small crystals.

frames.name: stone_arch
frames.prompt: A wide natural stone arch, a single big curved rock bridge with an open gap beneath it, mossy on top, with hanging vines from its underside.

frames.name: crystal_cluster
frames.prompt: A cluster of tall glowing prismatic crystals in pastel pink, violet and teal, pointing up at different angles from a small rocky base.

frames.name: mushroom_grove
frames.prompt: A grove of large glowing mushrooms of different sizes in soft pink, blue and violet with pale gills, on a small mossy mound.

frames.name: waterfall_ribbon
frames.prompt: A thin tall waterfall ribbon pouring straight down, pale blue-white with a soft misty top edge and a little spray at the bottom, no rock around it.

frames.name: mossy_ledge
frames.prompt: A floating chunk of mossy rock, a broad flat-topped ledge with a rounded rocky underside, thick moss and hanging roots along its edges.
